name: Campaign Monitor
summary: Email campaigns with strong templates and client-friendly management for brands and agencies. Automation depth is lighter than dedicated platforms.
best_for: small businesses and nonprofits that want polished, reliable email without a technical marketer - Campaign Monitor's own partner profile (July 2025) describes its buyer as a 10-100 person business with under 25,000 subscribers, sending one to ten campaigns a month and spending $100-$1,500 a month on the tool, self-service - plus agencies that manage sends for clients
skip_if: you need deep behavioral automation and CRM-grade journeys (ActiveCampaign-class tools fit better), or your list is large but low-engagement — prune first
honest_knock: You pay for contacts, not sends — so a large, quiet list costs the same as a large, active one, and dormant subscribers are literally a line item. Clean your list before comparing prices anywhere. Campaign Monitor's strength is polished, agency-friendly email; its automation depth is lighter than dedicated marketing-automation platforms, so know which of the two jobs you're actually buying.

plans.name: Lite
plans.includes: monthly send cap of five times your contact count

pricing.plans_source: summarised from pricing.notes; every plan name and amount appears verbatim in those notes
pricing.notes: Contact-based, on three tiers - Lite (with a monthly send cap of five times your contact count), Essentials (unlimited sends) and Premier (priority and phone support). We could not re-verify a plan amount on 2026-09-14 either: the page prints the euro sign and the words '/month' with nothing between them until you pick a contact count in its slider. That is now the fourth reading in a row with no plan price in the page itself. The only figure the page publishes is the Website Builder add-on at EUR 9 a month from an EU address - our July and August captures both read the same line as $10. Annual billing takes 10% off and nonprofits are offered a further 15%, which the page states for the first time in our captures. There is no paid-free tier, though the comparison table now labels its trial column 'the Free plan' while the contacts row under it says 500 contacts for the 30-day free trial and the send row says a 500-email limit - so the word 'Free' there is the trial, not a permanent plan. The contact brackets run 0-500, 501-2,500, 2,501-5,000, 5,001-10,000, 10,001-15,000, 15,001-25,000, 25,001-50,000 and 50,001+. Older readings put Lite around EUR 12 and Essentials around EUR 29 at 500 contacts, climbing steeply with list size - treat those as indicative and take your own figure from the slider. Note also that the product is listed as Campaign Monitor by Marigold. Campaign Monitor's own partner one-pager for small businesses (dated July 2025, from the partner resources) lists starting prices of $12 a month for Lite, $29 for Essentials (first month $2.90) and $159 for Premier. Treat those as the floor at the smallest contact count and as a vendor figure more than a year old, not as today's quote - the live page still needs the slider before it shows a plan amount.
